Description.description: Declarative recipe for a recurring or on-demand AI summary. Binds a target Dataverse entity, a query that defines which records are summarised, a prompt that defines how, a cadence that defines when, and an output destination. The run-summary-config flow consumes these rows and produces csp_aisummarycache entries.
